about: Cleveland Museum of Art online collection: search and filter artworks (keyword, artist, culture, type, medium, department, gallery, on view, recent acquisitions), autocomplete collection terms, get artwork details, related artworks, gallery locations and deep-zoom image info.

commands.summary: Search the CMA collection by keyword, with optional filters (type, department, artist, culture, on view, recently acquired), paged by offset

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword search: artist, title, subject or accession number. Leave empty to browse the whole collection.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Page size (sent to the API as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: type
params.description: Artwork type, e.g. Painting, Print, Drawing, Sculpture, Photograph

params.name: department
params.description: Curatorial department, e.g. 'American Painting and Sculpture', 'Modern European Painting and Sculpture'

params.name: currently_on_view
params.description: Only artworks currently on view in the galleries

commands.summary: Get full details of one artwork by accession number (title, date, artist, culture, medium, measurements, credit line, description, provenance, images)
List the 'See Also' related artworks shown on an artwork's detail page
List the museum's gallery locations (values accepted by the gallery= filter of search-artworks)
Get deep-zoom (DZI) metadata for an artwork image: full pixel width/height, tile size and format

params.name: image_id
params.description: Hex image id from the artwork's zoomify/DZI URL in get-artwork data
